about: Nitrogen (N₂) is a colourless, inert gas that makes up about 78% of air. Because it does not react with most materials, it is used to blanket and purge tanks and pipelines, protect food in packaging, pressurise systems and shield laser cutting.

We supply compressed nitrogen in cylinders and can arrange liquid nitrogen for cryogenic uses. Nitrogen displaces oxygen, so use it only in well-ventilated areas and never enter tanks or confined spaces that have been purged with it.
